steps.caption: Open More → Automation. The Failed counter shows 1.
In Needs attention, open the failed job.
The run page: Failed, when it started and finished.
What went wrong: the failed step and its error in plain words — a timeout, after 3 attempts.
Records affected: the meetings this job was working on.
Steps that worked keep their results — they will not run again.
Will it retry by itself? No — retries are used up. What to do: check the error, then use Retry.
Only the failed step ran again. The job is now Done.
History shows every action: started, step finished, manual retry — with who did it.
Back to Automation: the second job here is Paused.
A paused run waits. Resume continues where it stopped. Running jobs show Pause instead.
Cancel stops it for good (admins). Finished steps and their results are kept.
The job is now Cancelled — nothing else will run for it.
